label: first input token is digit 3 (t=0)
explanation: Update-gate unit 86 fires only at step t=0, and only when the first original token is the digit 3. Every activation lands on that step and every such step is active, so dev P=R=F1=1. Magnitude is constant (about 0.013 above threshold) because at t=0 the hidden state is the fixed initial state, so z depends on the input token alone. It never fires on a 3 at a later position, on any other first token, on the delimiter, or anywhere in the copy phase. In effect it is a narrow lookup on the input embedding at the first step, not a feature that tracks context.

issues: All claims hold up. On test, precision, recall, F1, mass recall and correlation are all 1.0 (3258 active, 3258 predicted), with 0 misses and 0 false positives.
Profile confirms it: activation only at t=0 (and so at orig_idx 0); zero on the delimiter and in the copy phase; magnitude is constant at 0.013 (mean = median = max).
Each condition alone is far too broad: in_tok=='3' alone gives precision 0.083, and t==0 alone gives precision 0.033. So it does not fire on a 3 at later positions or on other first tokens.

Procedural caveat: this analysis, like the original, used features/copy_gru_v1_neuron_baseline_store, not features/copy_transcoder_v2_1of5, the subsampled data the user pointed to. Whether that store was the right target is a question for the orchestrator.
